# ProFiler Suite

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProFiler

ProFiler Suite is a local-first desktop file manager for private document collections. It is a Windows-oriented PySide6 application for indexing local folders, searching documents, running OCR, handling PDF workflows, detecting duplicates, and reviewing files for privacy risks before sharing.

Core files:

- `Profiler_Suite_V15.py`: main desktop app
- `ProFiler_Datenschutzampel.py`: standalone privacy traffic-light helper
- `SQLiteViewer.py`: local SQLite index viewer
- `import_excel_to_profiler.py`: imports existing file lists
- `README.md`: English user-facing overview
- `README_de.md`: German user-facing overview
- `requirements.txt`: Python dependencies

Important capabilities:

- local SQLite file index
- full-text document search
- OCR via Tesseract
- PDF encryption, decryption, extraction, OCR, text removal, and export
- duplicate and version review via SHA-256 fingerprints
- privacy review and redaction/anonymization assistance
- optional ProSync companion launcher
- redacted workspace export/import for reviews and handoffs

Privacy note:

The app supports redaction and anonymization workflows but does not guarantee complete removal of sensitive information. Manual review remains required before publishing or sharing generated files.
